title_template: {work_unit_id} — Define Human-by-Exception durable session resume under existing authority only
goal: Define a durable Human-by-Exception session-resume contract that can recover from interrupted sessions and expired historical Writer Leases using only already-canonical authority, fresh Provider Truth and explicit no-replay boundaries.
scope: define durable checkpoint fields for Human-by-Exception control-plane continuation
require fresh canonical main, Provider Truth, open work-unit and branch readback before resume
classify expired historical ACTIVE Writer Leases as historical observations that are never reused
require a fresh monotonic Writer Lease generation when continuation resumes after lease expiry
bind resumed execution to the same canonical work unit and bounded branch without replaying completed transactions
preserve OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED as no-mutation or fail-closed outcomes
forbidden_scope: create, infer or broaden provider-state, issue, branch, pull-request, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
rewrite or retrospectively release expired historical Writer Lease records without separate exact authority
replay completed steady-state transactions after session interruption
resume from stale Provider Truth, stale canonical main, stale work-unit selection or stale branch state
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: durable checkpoint and resume inputs are machine-verifiable and bound to fresh Provider Truth
expired historical Writer Leases are never reused, reactivated or silently stolen
resume requires a fresh monotonic claim when no unexpired owned lease exists
completed steady-state transactions cannot replay after interruption
automatic continuation remains limited to explicit already-canonical delegated authority
owner escalation, WAIT, STOP, separate-authority and BLOCKED remain distinct no-mutation/fail-closed outcomes
resume contract grants no new mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
